questions.def: Future passive requires 'will be' + past participle.
questions.question: The new bridge ___ next year.

questions.def: Past passive requires 'was/were' + past participle.
questions.question: The report ___ by the committee last week.

questions.def: 'We' requires plural 'were'; past passive.
questions.question: We ___ about the change yesterday.

questions.def: 'Mistakes' is plural, so use 'were' in the passive.
questions.question: Mistakes ___ made, but we can learn from them.

questions.def: Singular noun 'problem' needs singular 'is'.
questions.question: The problem ___ currently being addressed by experts.

questions.def: Past passive: 'was' + past participle 'built'.
questions.question: The house ___ in 1920.

questions.def: 'Hasn't been' is present perfect passive, for unfinished actions.
questions.question: The email ___ sent yet.

questions.def: 'Is known' is present passive for a general truth.
questions.question: He ___ known to be a reliable source.

questions.def: 'Is being repaired' is present continuous passive.
questions.question: The car ___ at the moment.

questions.def: 'Suspect' is singular, so 'is' is correct.
questions.question: The suspect ___ being questioned by police.

questions.def: Use 'has been' for a recently completed action.
questions.question: The meeting ___ postponed until next week.

questions.def: 'Was stolen' is simple past passive.
questions.question: My bike ___ last night.

questions.def: Future passive requires 'will be' + past participle.
questions.question: The truth ___ finally revealed.

questions.def: Singular 'decision' takes singular 'was' in past passive.
questions.question: The decision ___ made by the board.

questions.def: 'Will be published' is future passive.
questions.question: The book ___ next month.

questions.def: 'Flowers' is plural, so 'were' is correct.
questions.question: The flowers ___ watered yesterday.

questions.def: Singular 'project' needs singular 'is'.
questions.question: The project ___ being managed effectively.

questions.def: 'Was written' is simple past passive.
questions.question: The essay ___ by him.

questions.def: 'Report' is singular, so 'is' is correct.
questions.question: The report ___ to be finished soon.

questions.def: 'Documents' is plural, so 'are' is correct.
questions.question: The documents ___ being reviewed now.

questions.def: 'Are cleaned' is present simple passive.
questions.question: The windows ___ every week.

questions.def: 'Problem' is singular, so 'has' is correct.
questions.question: The problem ___ already been solved.

questions.def: 'Rules' is plural, so 'are' is correct.
questions.question: The rules ___ being changed.

questions.def: Passive voice: subject receives the action. Past simple passive: was/were + past participle.
questions.question: The new bridge ___ by the construction company last year.

questions.def: 'Should be + past participle' expresses a recommendation in the passive voice.
questions.question: The documents ___ before the meeting starts.

questions.def: Use passive voice to show the subject received the information.
questions.question: I ___ that the meeting has been postponed.

questions.def: 'Mistakes' is plural, so the verb must agree: 'are' is correct.
questions.question: Mistakes ___ made, but they should be corrected quickly.

questions.def: Present continuous passive: action is happening now; is/are being + past participle.
questions.question: The project ___ by the team at the moment.

questions.def: Passive voice: the package receives the expectation. 'is expected' is correct.
questions.question: The package ___ to arrive tomorrow.

questions.def: Third conditional passive: 'would have been + past participle'.
questions.question: The problem ___ been solved if we had more resources.
